verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only general AI marketing claims: an 'AI-powered inbox', 'AI scheduling', and an 'AI CRM' that automates conversations. Separately, it documents non-AI performance tracking (ROI, lead quality). Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the user's CRM data inside the product, so these are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
